note: Adapted from the English redescription of Scheffrahn & Křeček 1999; this is the type species of Cryptotermes, its original description being Banks 1906 (Banks 1906: 337, Florida, USA), which was not obtained for this batch, so the morphology and measurements given here are all from Scheffrahn & Křeček 1999 (alates: 5 females and 3 males from 8 colonies; soldiers: 9 individuals from 9 colonies). The original notes that this species cannot be separated from C. mangoldi and C. undulans by most measurements and is merely the darkest of the three.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Body yellowish brown to light brown; sclerotized forewing veins light brown to brown, the wing membrane faintly smoky and very pale brown. Head light brown, with a brown transverse band between the compound eyes; the pale brown chevron on the forewing scale conspicuous. Antennae and pronotum light brown. Abdominal tergites yellowish brown to light brown. Labrum yellowish brown. Femora nearly white, the ends of the legs (including the tibiae) very pale brown. Abdominal sternites nearly white in the middle, yellowish brown to light brown at the sides. Head oval, the cranial sutures fine and distinct. Compound eyes medium-sized, nearly oval. Ocelli small, oval, touching the compound eyes. Antennae 13—17-segmented, usually 15 or 16, the segment formula variable. Pronotum nearly square, slightly wider than the head across the compound eyes; anterior margin slightly concave, posterior margin shallowly concave, the sides nearly parallel. The transverse band spot and the median line of the pronotum distinct. Radius of the forewing reaching the wing margin at half the wing length from the suture; radial sector with 5—6 branches. Arolium present.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Measurements (5 females and 3 males, 8 colonies, in mm): head length including the labrum 1.10—1.16 (1.14±0.021); head length to the postclypeus 0.82—0.90 (0.86±0.024); maximum head width across the compound eyes 0.88—0.93 (0.91±0.020); compound eye diameter 0.29—0.32 (0.30±0.013); shortest distance from the compound eye to the posterior margin of the head 0.11—0.16 (0.13±0.022); ocellus diameter 0.10—0.12 (0.11±0.0097); maximum pronotal length 0.62—0.70 (0.66±0.028); maximum pronotal width 0.83—0.95 (0.87±0.035); total body length with wings 8.52—9.66 (9.05±0.36); total body length without wings 4.97—5.61 (5.26±0.23); forewing length (from the suture) 6.67—7.53 (7.05±0.29); maximum forewing width 1.62—2.11 (1.90±0.17).

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head, in dorsal view, almost black and shining on the anterior quarter, grading posteriorly to rusty orange; in lateral view the anterior third almost black and rusty orange behind, with a pale yellow band along the foramen magnum. Mandibles dark chestnut brown. Anterior margin of the pronotum rusty orange, the remainder pale yellow. Head, in dorsal view, nearly square, with a slight to moderate concavity at the compound eyes; the sides slightly convex posteriorly, the posterior margin convex. The anterior edge of the frontal margin shallowly incised dorsally. Anterior third of the head (including the frontal margin and the frontal face) with shallow rugae. Frontal margin continuous with the vertex and the frontal face, with no or only a very shallow boundary to either (the boundary with the frontal face usually more distinct than that with the vertex). Frontal face moderately concave. Frontal face meeting the vertex face at 70°; the dorsal outline of the vertex distinctly concave. Labrum with short, nearly parallel sides, the apex triangular and slightly swollen. Frontal horns distinct, finger-like, with a deep groove between them and the clypeus. Genal horns very small, bluntly pointed. Genal horns far from the tips of the frontal horns, only weakly connected at the base; in dorsal view the frontal horns completely overlie the much smaller genal horns. Mandibles of moderate length, the distal half sickle-shaped, the apical tooth of the right mandible long and visible; the base usually slightly raised, bent in the middle, the dentition distinct. Mandibles nearly horizontal in lateral view. Compound eyes small, oval. Antennae 10—14-segmented, usually 11 or 12, the segment formula variable, usually 2>3>4<5. Pronotum shield-shaped, only slightly longer than wide; anterior margin rusty orange.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Measurements (9 individuals, 9 colonies, in mm): head length to the tip of the mandibles 1.48—1.69 (1.60±0.069); head length to the frontal horns 1.26—1.38 (1.29±0.041); frontal margin width 1.06—1.13 (1.10±0.023); outer span of the frontal horns 0.82—0.87 (0.84±0.017); maximum head width 1.08—1.14 (1.11±0.020); head height without the postmentum 0.77—0.87 (0.82±0.026); maximum pronotal width 1.00—1.14 (1.06±0.042); maximum pronotal length 0.75—0.88 (0.81±0.040); left mandible length (apex to ventral articulation) 0.72—0.77 (0.75±0.016); total body length 3.47—4.95 (4.25±0.46).
